def transform(grid):
    # A vertical divider splits side-by-side fields; otherwise a uniform row
    # separates stacked fields. Output their nonzero overlap in color 2.
    if 1 in grid[0]:
        c = next(j for j, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v == 1)
        w = min(c, len(grid[0]) - c - 1)
        return [[2 if grid[r][c-w+j] != 0 and grid[r][c+1+j] != 0 else 0
                 for j in range(w)] for r in range(len(grid))]
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    return [[2 if top[r][j] != 0 and bottom[r][j] != 0 else 0
             for j in range(len(top[0]))] for r in range(len(top))]
